==English==
{{wp}}
[[Image:Bette_%C3%A0_c%C3%B4tes_rouges01.jpg|thumb|'''chard''' ({{taxfmt|Beta vulgaris|species}})]]

===Etymology===
From earlier {{m|en|card|id=chard}} (remodelled after {{m|en|chardoon}}, obsolete form of {{m|en|cardoon}}), from {{bor|en|frm|carde}}, from {{der|en|la|carduus||thistle}}. {{doublet|en|cardoon}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/t͡ʃɑːd/|a=UK}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-chard.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{IPA|en|/t͡ʃɑɹd/|a=US}}
** {{audio|en|En-us-chard.oga|a=GA}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɑː(ɹ)d|s=1}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# {{lb|en|uncountable|culinary}} The large [[edible]] leaves of the [[beet]] plant ({{taxlink|Beta vulgaris subsp. cicla|subspecies}}), having a slightly [[bitter]] taste and used as [[salad greens]] and in cooking.
#: {{syn|en|Swiss chard|silverbeet <l:AU,NZ>}}
#: {{hyponyms|en|perpetual spinach}}
# {{lb|en|culinary}} {{cap|artichoke}} leaves and shoots, [[blanch]]ed to eat.

====Derived terms====
* {{l|en|rainbow chard}}
* {{l|en|Swiss chard}}
